database.routers.simulation

Simulation management endpoints

Provides API for running and managing twin simulations

Module Contents

database.routers.simulation.router
async database.routers.simulation.run_simulation(request: database.schemas.SimulationRequest, manager: database.dependencies.ManagerDep) → database.schemas.SimulationResponse[source]

Run a new simulation with specified parameters

This endpoint: 1. Creates a new simulation run record 2. Executes the SimPy simulation 3. Stores results in MES format 4. Calculates KPIs 5. Returns run summary

async database.routers.simulation.list_simulations(session: database.dependencies.SessionDep, run_type: str | None = None, status: str | None = None, page: int = Query(1, ge=1), page_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100)) → database.schemas.SimulationListResponse[source]

List simulation runs with optional filtering

Filter by: - run_type: baseline, experiment, optimization, recommendation - status: pending, running, completed, failed

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation(run_id: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → database.schemas.SimulationResponse[source]

Get details of a specific simulation run

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation_data(run_id: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep, limit: int = Query(1000, ge=1, le=10000), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0)) → Dict[str, Any][source]

Get raw simulation data in MES format

Returns the simulation output data with pagination

async database.routers.simulation.get_simulation_kpis(run_id: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → database.schemas.KPISummary[source]

Get KPI summary for a simulation run

Calculates: - Mean OEE, Availability, Performance, Quality - Total production and scrap - Scrap rate

async database.routers.simulation.compare_simulations(baseline_run_id: str, comparison_run_id: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → database.schemas.ComparisonResponse[source]

Compare two simulation runs

Calculates deltas for all KPIs and determines if the difference is statistically significant

async database.routers.simulation.delete_simulation(run_id: str, session: database.dependencies.SessionDep) → Dict[str, str][source]

Delete a simulation run and all associated data

This will remove: - The run record - All simulation data - Any KPI snapshots
